decisions.reason: The source changes only the book-cover cropping requirement. The landing-page copy, general layout direction, and existing responsive rule for statistics and mechanics remain unchanged.
Making the landing-page book cover fully visible does not change any FAQ content.
The source concerns the landing-page cover image and does not change About-page content.
The cover-cropping correction does not change the current or planned product name.
The landing-page image visibility change has no effect on email authentication or dashboard access.
The source does not change email delivery behavior or transactional-email contents.
The book-cover presentation correction does not affect SIWE or any protected wallet-authentication flow.
The source does not alter public API authentication or exposed information.
Landing-page cover cropping is unrelated to which NFT-associated assets and state follow a transfer.
The cover-image correction does not change the deferred Transak fiat-mint flow or its configuration.
The request for full visibility of the landing-page book-cover image does not change NFT metadata fields or counters.
